name: BLE Gateway
summary: Bridges Bluetooth sensors into Signal K
description:
Scans for Bluetooth Low Energy sensors — temperature, humidity, battery monitors — and forwards their readings to a Signal K server.

Runs on the Waveshare ESP32-P4 boards (BLE via their ESP32-C6 co-processor, which is what two gateways here use in daily service; the PoE-ETH on its cable, the Touch-LCD boards on WiFi) and on the ESP32, S3 and C6. Not on the ESP32-C3: its boards have 4 MB of flash, too little for two copies of the image.

Also on the Waveshare ESP32-C5 WiFi 6 kit, using its PSRAM: Bluetooth plus WiFi plus the Signal K client does not fit an ESP32-C5's internal RAM alone, so a C5 without PSRAM cannot run it.

boards.notes: Needs the module's PSRAM: an ESP32-C5 without it cannot run Bluetooth beside WiFi. Tested on the N16R8 (8 MB PSRAM).

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-P4: POE-ETH, Touch-LCD-7B or Touch-LCD-X
boards.notes: One image for all three boards: the PoE-ETH runs on its cable, the Touch-LCD boards on WiFi with the screen left dark. Releases up to 1.0.0 have WiFi off and only work on the PoE-ETH. On the PoE-ETH, never connect USB and Ethernet at the same time: powering the board from USB and PoE together damages it.
